established: The blind-spot audit runs on a schedule and reports new blind pairs: .github/workflows/survivors.yml (s0fractal/warrant#178, merge 16e5a66) runs weekly and on dispatch; it runs the curated mutants under every test file, tools/claims.py audit --json over those full matrices, and the generated-mutant hunt, and reports against the previous run's list on the same branch the new blind (claim, mutant) pairs and the BLIND and NEW survivors. First run 39990015098 on 16e5a66: success; 8631 generated mutants, 1451 survived; 545 curated mutants, 1076 candidate blind pairs in 205 claims (43 confined); no previous list yet.
